story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. The courtyard of a Hanoi tube house: a tiled yard with low stools, a charcoal stove and a big pot (kit place: garden); afternoon, night, dawn
2. The family's front room with the ancestor altar (kit place: living-room); dawn
3. Hanoi's old quarter rooftops under New Year's Eve fireworks (kit place: village); midnight

KEY OBJECT (the owner's notes — draw it exactly so): Bánh chưng: a flat SQUARE parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible leaf texture (veins), tied with two pairs of thin pale bamboo strings each way (four strings crossing in a grid, NOT a ribbon, NO bow), a darker green leaf fold at the corners. States in order: wrapped (fresh bright green leaves, crisp strings) → cooking (the parcel in a big pot of boiling water, steam rising) → cooked (leaves darkened to deep olive and glossy, strings swollen, set on a plate on the altar).

Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội. Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt. An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt. Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn. Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân. Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng. Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe. Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ. An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre. Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách. Trên bàn thờ là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.

bible.logline: Một câu chuyện ấm áp về bánh chưng và tình bà cháu trong đêm giao thừa.

cast.name: Bé An
cast.look: Small child, round face, short black hair, wearing a simple áo bà ba in soft beige, bare feet

cast.name: Bà
cast.look: Elderly woman, gentle smile, silver hair in a bun, wearing a dark áo dài with subtle floral pattern, hands wrinkled

cast.name: Bánh chưng
cast.look: Flat square parcel wrapped in glossy green dong leaves with visible veins, tied with four thin pale bamboo strings in a grid, darker green leaf folds at corners

states.look: Fresh bright green leaves, crisp strings, square shape
Parcel submerged in boiling water, steam rising, leaves turning deep olive, strings swelling
Leaves darkened to deep olive glossy, strings swollen, parcel resting on a ceramic plate on the altar

parts.look: flat square block about as thick as a thumb, wrapped tight in whole leaves, edges sharp and corners folded to points
glossy bright green leaf sheets covering all faces, clear vein lines running lengthwise, darker green triangular folds tucked at each corner
four thin pale bamboo strips, two running left–right and two front–back, crossing in a neat grid on top and bottom, no bow or knot visible
darker green leaf tips folded into sharp triangles at the four corners, tucked under the grid strings

states.change: fresh bright green glossy leaves, crisp pale bamboo grid strings, sharp square silhouette with dark green corner folds
parcel submerged in bubbling water, steam rising, leaves turning deep olive green, bamboo strings thickened and swollen
leaves darkened to deep olive glossy, strings visibly swollen, parcel resting on a white ceramic plate on a wooden altar shelf

shots.description: Wide view of the tube‑house courtyard in warm afternoon light; low stools, charcoal stove with big pot, An and grandma sit side by side on stools, ingredients on a mat.
shots.dialogue: Chiều Ba Mươi Tết, bé An cùng bà gói bánh chưng trong sân nhà ở phố cổ Hà Nội.

shots.description: Medium framing on grandma spreading glossy green dong leaves on the mat, white glutinous rice, mung bean and pork filling visible; An watches nearby.
shots.dialogue: Bà trải lá dong xanh lên mâm, đong gạo nếp trắng, nhân đậu xanh và thịt.

shots.description: Close‑up on An's small hands folding a leaf into a perfect square under grandma's guiding fingers; the first wrapped parcel begins to form.
shots.dialogue: An học bà gấp lá thật vuông và buộc lạt tre thật chặt.

shots.description: Two‑shot of An proudly holding the first square cake, grandma beaming and waving approval; afternoon light softens toward early evening.
shots.dialogue: Chiếc bánh đầu tiên An tự gói, bà khen vuông vắn như bánh của người lớn.

shots.description: Night falls; the courtyard glows with lantern light, the big pot boils vigorously, steam rising, An and grandma sit close by the stove.
shots.dialogue: Đêm xuống, nồi bánh sôi lục bục trên bếp lửa hồng giữa sân.

shots.description: Over‑the‑shoulder from behind grandma, both faces turned to the pot; grandma points, telling the legend of Lang Liêu offering cake to King Hùng.
shots.dialogue: Hai bà cháu ngồi canh nồi bánh, bà kể chuyện Lang Liêu dâng bánh cho vua Hùng.

shots.description: Close‑up on grandma's finger pointing at the square cake beside the pot, An's eyes wide with wonder; night shadows deepen.
shots.dialogue: Bà chỉ chiếc bánh vuông như mặt đất, An tròn mắt lắng nghe.

shots.description: Midnight over Hanoi's old quarter rooftops; fireworks burst in colorful arcs, terracotta tiles glimmer, the city breathes celebration.
shots.dialogue: Đêm giao thừa, pháo hoa nở rực trên những mái ngói phố cổ.

shots.description: Back in the courtyard at deep night, lanterns dim; An sleeps curled on grandma's lap, tiny hand still clutching a bamboo string from the cake.
shots.dialogue: An ngủ gục trên vai bà, tay vẫn nắm sợi lạt tre.

shots.description: Dawn light spills into the front room; An darts across the wooden floor toward the altar, the room still quiet.
shots.dialogue: Sáng mùng Một, An mở mắt và chạy ra phòng khách.

shots.description: Insert detail on the ancestor altar: a ceramic plate holds the cooked bánh chưng, leaves deep olive glossy, strings swollen, the first square cake made by An's own hands.
shots.dialogue: Trên bàn thờ là chiếc bánh chưng vuông vức đầu tiên do chính tay An gói.
